workarounds.symptom: [Bug] workflow streams publish treats any object with `metadata: {}` as a raw Payload and drops its data
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(workflow-streams): require encoding to detect Payloads. Target files: contrib/workflow-streams/src/client.ts, contrib/workflow-streams/src/is-payload.ts, contrib/workflow-streams/src/workflow.ts. - Workflow stream publish treated any object with `metadata: {}` as a raw Payload (vacuous `Object.values({}).every(...)`), so OpenAI/Stripe-shaped values skipped conversion. - Require `metadata.encoding` (Uint8Array-like) to identify Payloads; shared helper + unit tests. (Ref: https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-typescript/pull/2680)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] `npx @temporalio/create` on Node 26 makes a project that does not compile (TS6046)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Add Node 26 to test matrix. Drop Node 20.. Target files: .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/release.yml. - Add Node 26 to test matrix - Drop Node 20 from test matrix (Ref: https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-typescript/pull/2549)

Fix: fix(worker): load the Workflow bundler on demand. Target files: packages/worker/src/index.ts, packages/worker/src/worker.ts, packages/worker/src/workflow/bundle-workflow-code.ts. `@temporalio/worker` no longer loads `workflow/bundler` on import. It is imported the first time Workflow code is bundled: (Ref: https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-typescript/pull/2516)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Native Temporal (Node 26+, ECMAScript 2026) is not made deterministic inside workflow sandboxes
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(workflow): make Temporal.Now use workflow time. Target files: packages/workflow/src/global-overrides.ts, packages/workflow/src/interfaces.ts, packages/test/src/test-workflows.ts. Node 26 exposes the native `Temporal` global in workflow isolates, but the sandbox currently only makes `Date` reads replay-stable. Calls to `Temporal.Now` can therefore observe host wall-clock time during workflow replay. (Ref: https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-typescript/pull/2488)

workarounds.symptom: Worker.run() rejects with IllegalStateError, masking the error that ended the worker
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(worker): preserve original error when shutdown finalization fails. Target files: packages/worker/src/worker.ts, packages/test/src/test-worker-lifecycle.ts, changelog/fixed/silly-wombat.md. When `Worker.run()` encounters a fatal error—such as `GracefulShutdownPeriodExpiredError` when `shutdownForceTime` expires while activities are still executing, or a `TransportError` when a namespace is deleted while polling—it initiates shutdown cleanup. During cleanup, `this.nativeWorker.finalizeShutdown()` is awaited in a ... (Ref: https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-typescript/pull/2543)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] parseWorkflowCode retains bundle source maps when source-map-support is loaded
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(worker): avoid retaining bundle source maps when preloading workflow code. Target files: packages/worker/src/worker.ts, changelog/fixed/forgetful-origami-crane.md. `parseWorkflowCode` now passes `displayErrors: false` to `script.runInContext` when it preloads the Workflow bundle. Adds a test and a changelog entry. (Ref: https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-typescript/pull/2459)
